name: Sunset Slush
description: Shaved ice downtown. The hot-afternoon answer on the W Main end.

name: Brevard Downtown Chocolates
description: Chocolates and scoops on W Main, a block from the trailhead.

name: The Yard
description: Playset, kids’ bike park, and ice cream at 284 Railroad Ave — the one stop that gets them riding.

name: Rocky's Grill & Soda Shop
description: Soda fountain on Broad St. Milkshakes, floats, and a lunch counter.

name: Kilwins
description: Hand-paddled ice cream and fudge on E Main. Easy downtown stop.

name: White Squirrel Arcade
description: Italian ice at 40 N Caldwell St, with arcade games to go with it.

name: Dolly's Dairy Bar
description: The Pisgah classic, at the far end of the bridge connector. Mostly flat the whole way from town.

name: Silversteen Park
description: Neighborhood park on Hillview St, a couple of blocks off the West Main trailhead.

name: Brevard First United Methodist
description: Church playground open to the public after 12pm Monday through Friday.

name: Franklin Park
description: Neighborhood playground and shade just south of downtown.

name: Silvermont Mansion & Park
description: Big playground on the Silvermont lawn at 364 E Main, with a picnic pavilion and the mansion grounds to wander.

name: Jameson's Joy (Ninja Park)
description: Ninja-course fitness park at the Parks & Rec fields. Open 24 hours and fully accessible.

name: Broad Street Wines
description: Bottle shop and wine bar at 30 S Broad, right in the middle of town.

name: The Map Room at D.D. Bullwinkel’s
description: Beer and wine on draft at 60 E Main, plus events and film screenings.

name: Brevard Brewing Company
description: Lagers at 63 E Main, a block from the downtown link. Racks out front.

name: Noblebräu Brewing · 185 King Street
description: Taproom on the King St row, a short block off the path.

name: Griffon & Sphynx
description: Small taproom at 212 King St, at the north end of the King St row.

name: Oskar Blues (Tasty Weasel Taproom)
description: Taproom, food, and a big lawn at 342 Mountain Industrial Dr.

name: Ecusta Brewing Company
description: At 451 Ecusta Rd, a few steps off the path. Easy post-ride pint.

name: Earth Mountain
description: Closest shop to the downtown end. Service, parts, and local advice.

name: Cyckel Worx
description: Mid-path repair shop. Handy if something goes wrong away from town.

name: Sycamore Cycles
description: At 112 Hendersonville Hwy. From the roundabout, turn left instead of right — you do have to cross the road.

name: Squatch Bikes & Brews
description: Shop and taproom in one at 170 King St, on the King St row.

name: Weevil Outdoor Supply
description: Gear shop with beer on tap at 367 Hendersonville Hwy, past the north end of the path.

name: The Hub & Pisgah Tavern
description: Shop and tavern at 11 Mama’s Pl, out past Dolly’s toward the forest entrance.

name: Railroad Depot Repair Stand
description: At Jimmy Harris Railroad Depot Park — pump and tools, plus restrooms, parking, and the ballerina sculpture.

name: Mid-Path Fix-It Stand
description: Pump plus a chain tool, with a water bottle filler beside it.

name: Pisgah Forest Repair Stand
description: Last stand before the bridge — the pump gauge actually works.
